title: Module 4 Critic Report (PROVISIONAL, report_version module4-critic-report-v0)
description: Describes the JSON produced by src/critic/report.py (build_critic_report / save_report / --json) as currently implemented. PROVISIONAL - NOT a final contract: the input is still Module 4's temporary test schema 'module4-temporary-test-schema-v0', because Module 3's actual ExecutionResult schema has not been received. Fields or values may change when Module 3 integration is done. Derived from the generated sample module4_sample_critic_report.json and the code paths in report.py / stats_checks.py.

job_id.description: Job identifier: the one provided by the caller, else the input's experiment_id, else null (never invented).

job_id_source.description: Where job_id came from; null when job_id is null.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC by default, seconds precision). A caller may pass its own value.

schema_version.description: Input schema the report was built from. Currently always 'module4-temporary-test-schema-v0'.

is_temporary_schema.description: True while the input is the Module 4 temporary test schema (not Module 3's ExecutionResult).

target_effect.description: Target Cohen's d for power analysis (default 0.5).

verdict.description: Overall job verdict. 'incomplete' = some results checked with no issues, others could not be assessed.

explanation.description: Plain-language summary built only from check results.

checks.description: Count of individual check results by status.

entries.description: One entry per metric, then per comparison, in input order.

notes.description: Standing caveats (temporary schema, derived effect sizes, power method, scope of verdicts).

kind.description: 'unknown' is only produced defensively for checks whose target matches no record (not expected in normal use).

name.description: Record name; unique within its kind.

test_name.description: Statistical test for comparisons; null for metrics.

p_value.description: null when no p-value was reported.

confidence_interval.description: Interval as reported; null when the record has no interval (comparisons never carry one in the temporary schema).

effect_size.description: DERIVED effect size for t-tests only; null otherwise.

unavailable_fields.description: Which of the four fields above are null (test_name is never listed for metrics).

reported.description: p-value as reported in the input.

operator.description: How p was reported, e.g. '<' for 'p < 0.001'.

recomputed.description: p recomputed from the statistic by SciPy; null if the check was skipped.

source.const: derived from the t statistic and sample sizes

details.description: Check-specific values (e.g. recomputed_p, rounding_tolerance, power_at_target_effect). Keys differ by check and by situation, so they are NOT fixed by this provisional schema; consumers should treat them as informational.
